GOVERNED_EXACT.meaning: Head sha and lastModified compare exactly in --check, like gated rows. Any head move is INVALID ('governed revision changed') and prepare_hf_inventory_refresh.py stops with SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Pins the observed head, not the release binding's own revision.

SOURCE_TRACKED.meaning: Unlisted rows. Identical to the earlier ungated comparison: a later head is tolerated only when the stored revision still resolves with the same card digest; card, tags and policy fields compare exactly.

APPEND_ONLY_EVIDENCE.meaning: Reserved for a file-level append proof over the Hub tree API. Not implemented; the validator rejects any entry using it.
